scheme_name: AICTE-INAE Travel Grant Scheme For Engineering Students From AICTE Approved Engineering College/Institution
other_conditions: A student is eligible for financial support only once during the course of his/her study.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹1,00,000 per student covering 100% registration and visa fees, 50% of airfare (or AC II‑Class train fare) and related travel expenses.
documents_required: Letter of acceptance for presenting a research paper accepted in an international conference/seminar/symposium/workshop/exhibition
